label: Workshop 2
title: PersonaDesk agents on Hermes
summary: Run one email assistant per persona on Hermes Agent: a Hermes profile per persona, the PersonaDesk plugin with persona-scoped tools and a guard hook, human review of every draft, and a local-only mail simulator.
hardware: CPU with a hosted model; GPU for the full local stack

commands.label: Create the operator allowlist
commands.note: Then replace your-os-username with your OS account name.

commands.label: Run one job with the fake worker
commands.run: uv run personadesk --profile pd-priya --hermes-bin scripts/fake_hermes.py run --fixture priya-001

prompts.label: Why a guard hook?
prompts.prompt: PersonaDesk uses a guard hook and human review so nothing is ever sent automatically. Explain how a Hermes plugin hook can block a tool call, and why the persona comes from the active profile instead of a tool argument.

prompts.label: Profiles and skills
prompts.prompt: Explain how Hermes profiles, SOUL.md and plugins fit together, using the PersonaDesk personas (pd-priya, pd-daniel, pd-noah) as examples.
